mapper.insert: INSERT INTO documents ( group_id, uploaded_user_id, file_name, file_extension, context_type, file_size, file_hash, storage_bucket, storage_object_key, status, deleted, failure_reason, uploaded_at, processed_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{groupId}, #{uploadedUserId}, #{fileName}, #{fileExtension}, #{contextType}, #{fileSize}, #{fileHash}, #{storageBucket}, #{storageObjectKey}, #{status}, #{deleted}, #{failureReason}, #{uploadedAt}, #{processedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, group_id, uploaded_user_id, file_name, file_extension, context_type, file_size, file_hash, storage_bucket, storage_object_key, status, deleted, failure_reason, uploaded_at, processed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM documents where id = #{documentId} and group_id = #{groupId} and deleted = false
